subject: Request: DPIA artifacts, KMS attestation, and subprocessor evidence for HorizonMed onboarding
messages:
From: Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@horizonmed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: itops@horizonmed.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: DPIA artifacts + KMS evidence request for onboarding

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As part of HorizonMed's vendor onboarding and DPIA that our privacy team is finalising, we need a bundle of privacy & security artifacts to close our internal review. Can you provide the following by EOD 28 Apr?

- Article 28 subprocessor registry (current list + locations) and an evidence packet for any subprocessors processing health-related data.
- An excerpt of your Article 30 processing records relevant to our integration (sample rows with processing purposes and categories of data).
- KMS/HSM attestation: architecture diagram (high level), key custody model, and recent key rotation log for the keys that protect customer data in production (we only need a summary for review; full logs can be uploaded to a secure portal).
- Encryption at-rest and in-transit controls (cipher suites, TLS versions).
- SOC 2 (or equivalent) latest report summary and any gap remediation notes from the last year.
- Confirmation of audit rights cadence (annual + on-demand with reasonable notice) and your preferred process for technical evidence transfer (portal vs SFTP vs on-site).

We may also request a short technical call with your infra/security lead (30 minutes) after we review. If any of the above requires an NDA or separate MSA addendum, flag it in your response.

Appreciate a tight turn on this — we have a compliance gate scheduled for the 30th.

Thanks,
Emma Brooks
Privacy Counsel
HorizonMed
(attachment: onboarding-checklist.xlsx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@horizonmed.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts + KMS evidence request for onboarding

Emma — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (subprocessors + commercial), and Karthik (security/ops) to assemble the package.

Plan / owners:
- Marissa: will pull and export the current Art.28 subprocessor registry and flag any subprocessors subject to health-data processing.
- Karthik: will prepare the KMS/HSM architecture summary, a redacted key-rotation log (summary rows only), and an excerpt of the Art.30 ledger for the HorizonMed integration. He'll also confirm cipher/TLS posture.
- I'll coordinate the delivery mechanism and confirm whether HorizonMed needs a signed addendum / MSA change.

Timeline: aiming to deliver a secure portal upload by 2027-04-24 for your initial review; followups (SOC2 summary and any deeper logs) by 2027-04-28 if needed. If that works, we'll schedule a 30-min tech sync for 2027-04-26.

Marissa/Karthik — please share anything you think should be redacted for security reasons; we can provide fuller evidence in the secure portal link Emma suggested or via a gated share.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 09:15 AM Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@horizonmed.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the walkthrough earlier...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@horizonmed.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 15:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts + KMS evidence request for onboarding

Emma / Grace,

Attached is the initial package we discussed. Note: some attachments are redacted to remove operational identifiers; full detail is available in the secure evidence portal (link below) once HorizonMed's access is provisioned.

Attachments included (summary):
- redwood_art28_subprocessors_list.csv (column: subprocessor, service, region, processing_scope)
- redwood_processing_ledger_excerpt.csv (sample rows showing processing purpose, categories of data, retention)
- redwood_kms_key_rotation_log_2024Q4.pdf (summary: key id, rotation timestamp, rotation_type = scheduled, rotate_principal = ops-keymgr)
- redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (cover page + control status; redwood SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA for full copy)

Secure portal: https://evidence.redwood.ai/portal/HZN-7832
DocuSign (DPA addendum - optional): https://docusign.com/req/9f8a-hrz

Quick notes on a couple of items you asked for:
- KMS custody: production customer encryption keys are stored in a KMS-backed HSM (FIPS 140-2 level-3 validated hardware where required). We operate a multi-tenant KMS with per-tenant key wrapping; hardware custody is managed by our key ops team.
- Rotation: scheduled quarterly rotation for wrapping keys; the attached log is a redacted export. We can provide additional columns in the portal for auditors upon provisioning.
- Audit rights: Redwood's standard position is annual audit + on-demand with 30 days' notice; we are open to discussing limited-scope on-demand checks for regulated customers.

Grace: @Karthik — Marissa attached the files we talked about. Can you confirm the ledger excerpt contains the mapping Emma requested (processing categories + lawful basis)?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_art28_subprocessors_list.csv, redwood_kms_key_rotation_log_2024Q4.pdf, redwood_processing_ledger_excerpt.csv, redwood_soc2-summary.pdf)

From: Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@horizonmed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts + KMS evidence request for onboarding

Thanks — received the package and portal link. A few follow-ups after a quick review:

1) The processing ledger excerpt looks good but can you provide one additional sample row with a mapping to the data subject category (e.g., patient identifier vs provider contact) and the specific legal basis we will rely on for processing (consent, contract performance, healthcare provision, etc.)? That helps our DPIA templates.

2) Audit rights: HorizonMed's policy requires written confirmation that on-demand audits are available up to twice per year with a minimum 15-business-day notice for technical evidence reviews. Is Redwood able to commit to that cadence in the DPA addendum? If Redwood prefers 30 days, please let us know and we can discuss risk exceptions.

3) For the KMS material: can Karthik confirm whether key wrapping is customer-scoped keys (per-tenant) or a shared wrapping key per region? Also confirm whether any customer key material is exported outside HSM (short answer: no/yes).

If you can answer (1) and (3) and confirm the audit cadence, we should be able to close the compliance gate next week. If it's helpful, I'm available for a 30-min call Monday 26 Apr 10:00-11:30 BST.

Best,
Emma Brooks
Privacy Counsel
HorizonMed
(attachment: horizonmed-dpia-template.docx)
